name: Flashcards (SRS)
description: Digital cards with question on front, answer on back. Spaced Repetition Algorithm (SM-2/FSRS) schedules review intervals based on recall confidence. Core mechanism: active retrieval with spaced scheduling.

name: Active Recall
description: Actively retrieving information from memory without looking at source material. UI prompts user to recall answers before revealing correct info. Foundation of most other techniques.

name: Pomodoro Technique
description: Timer-based focus sessions (25 min work / 5 min break). UI shows countdown with session tracking, break prompts, and daily focus statistics. Productivity multiplier for any study method.

name: Feynman Technique
description: Explain a concept in simple language as if teaching a child. UI provides: concept input, plain-English explanation field, identify gaps step, simplify/analogize step. Identifies knowledge gaps.

name: Blurting
description: Write down everything you remember about a topic in a timed session (5-10 min) without notes. Then compare to source material to find gaps. UI: timer + text area + comparison view.

name: Mind Mapping
description: Hierarchical diagram connecting related concepts around a central topic. Interactive canvas with drag-and-drop nodes, color coding, collapsible branches, and export.

name: Concept Mapping
description: Network diagram showing relationships between concepts with labeled edges ("causes", "is-a", "leads-to"). More structured than mind maps. UI: node-link editor with relationship labels.

name: Practice Quizzes
description: Auto-generated or user-created quizzes with multiple choice, true/false, and short answer. Immediate feedback with explanations. Randomized question order and difficulty scaling.

name: Cornell Note-Taking
description: Structured note page divided into: cue column (keywords/questions), notes column (main content), summary section at bottom. UI: split-pane editor with auto-formatting.

name: Summarization
description: Condense a passage into key points. UI: source text on left, summary input on right, optional AI comparison/additional points. Builds comprehension and identifying main ideas.

name: Self-Explanation
description: Explain the reasoning behind each step of a solution or concept out loud or in writing. UI: step-through interface prompting "Why?" and "How?" after each step.

name: Interleaving
description: Mix practice problems from different topics rather than blocking by topic. UI: mixed-problem generator that shuffles across subjects/topics, forces topic-switching.

name: Elaborative Interrogation
description: Generate "why" questions about facts and concepts, then answer them. UI: fact card with prompt "Why is this true?" + input field + reveals additional context.

name: Dual Coding
description: Combine verbal/text information with visual representations (diagrams, charts, sketches). UI: split canvas with text editor + drawing/import tools side by side.

name: Worked Examples
description: Step-by-step solved problem with each step revealed progressively. UI: collapsible step cards, annotated solutions, fade-out effect where later steps are hidden for self-completion.

name: Leitner System
description: Physical (or digital) boxes where cards advance based on correct recall. Box 1 (daily), Box 2 (every 2 days), Box 3 (weekly). Wrong answers drop back to Box 1. UI: animated box system.

name: SQ3R Method
description: Survey → Question → Read → Recite → Review. Structured reading workflow. UI: 5-step wizard guiding through each phase with note-taking at each stage.

name: PQ4R Method
description: Preview → Question → Read → Reflect → Recite → Review. Extended version of SQ3R with emphasis on reflection. UI: guided multi-step template with completion tracking.

name: Memory Palace (Method of Loci)
description: Associate items with spatial locations in a familiar environment. Walk through mentally to recall. UI: 3D or 2D spatial grid where users place "items" in rooms/locations.

name: Chunking
description: Group individual pieces of information into meaningful chunks. UI: drag-and-drop grouping interface, auto-chunk suggestions for numbers/sequences, practice mode.

name: Mnemonics
description: Create acronyms, acrostics, rhymes, or associative phrases. UI: mnemonic generator template, shared community mnemonics, convert-list-to-acronym tool.

name: Active Reading
description: Reading with annotation: highlight, margin notes, underline, questions. UI: PDF/text reader with highlight colors, margin note fields, sticky notes, bookmark system.

name: Teaching Others (AI Mode)
description: Explain concepts to an AI that asks follow-up questions. UI: chat interface where AI plays "student" asking clarifying questions. Highlights gaps in understanding.
bestFor: any subject where deep understanding is needed

name: Visualization
description: Create mental or on-screen visual representations of abstract concepts. UI: drawing canvas, pre-made diagram templates, image gallery, animation tools for processes.

name: Peer Discussion
description: Discuss concepts with peers to deepen understanding. UI: subject-specific chat rooms, structured discussion prompts, debate format, Q&A board with voting.

name: Practice Problems
description: Solve varied problems with increasing difficulty. UI: problem display with input area, step-by-step solution reveal, hint system, difficulty progression, answer validation.

name: Code Exercises
description: Interactive coding challenges with real-time compilation, test cases, and feedback. UI: code editor with syntax highlighting, test runner, console output, diff view for solutions.

name: Audio Recordings (Lectures)
description: Record and replay lectures or self-explanations. UI: audio recorder with playback speed control, transcript sync, bookmarkable timestamps, note-taking linked to timestamps.

name: Anki-Style Cards
description: Digital flashcards with SM-2 spaced repetition: three confidence buttons (Again/Hard/Good/Easy). UI: card flip animation, rating buttons, deck organization, scheduling visualization.

name: Cloze Deletion Cards
description: Cards with key information blanked out. Fill in the missing word/phrase. UI: text with highlighted blanks, type-in reveal, auto-generate cloze from selected text.

name: Image Occlusion Cards
description: Hide parts of an image (labels, areas) and quiz yourself. UI: image upload, rectangle/brush occlusion tool, reveal-on-click, occlusion layers for progressive disclosure.

name: Error Analysis
description: Log mistakes, categorize error type, review patterns. UI: mistake journal with tag categories, pattern recognition dashboard, targeted practice recommendations based on error frequency.

name: Free Recall
description: Write or type everything you remember from a study session without cues. UI: blank page with timer, then compare to source material via highlight-difference view.

name: Retrieval Grid
description: Grid of review questions where rows = topics and columns = time periods (last week, last month, etc.). Forces spaced retrieval across multiple topics. UI: interactive grid with color-coded confidence.

name: Categorization / Sorting
description: Drag items into correct categories. UI: drag-and-drop cards into category buckets, auto-check correctness, timed mode, competing categories.

name: Matching Exercises
description: Match items from two columns (term↔definition, cause↔effect, date↔event). UI: two-column layout, click-to-match lines, shuffle mode, timed scoring.

name: Fill-in-the-Blank
description: Complete sentences with missing words/phrases. UI: text with inline inputs, word bank option, auto-check, context-aware hint system.

name: Timeline Builder
description: Create interactive chronological timelines. UI: horizontal timeline with draggable events, zoom levels, category color coding, click-to-expand event details.

name: Diagram Labeling
description: Label parts of a diagram from memory. UI: image with numbered pointers, drag-label or type-label, self-check reveal, multiple difficulty levels (labels provided vs blank).

name: Comparative Matrix
description: Compare multiple concepts across shared dimensions in a grid. UI: editable table where rows = concepts, columns = criteria. Auto-highlights similarities/differences.

name: Shadowing (Language)
description: Repeat audio immediately after hearing it, mimicking pronunciation and intonation. UI: audio player with recording, waveform comparison, playback speed control, repeat section loops.

name: Rubber Duck Debugging
description: Explain code/reasoning line-by-line to an AI "duck" that signals confusion at unclear steps. UI: code paste + chat AI that asks "Why does this line work?" at each step.

name: Role-Playing Scenarios
description: Simulate real-world scenarios where knowledge is applied. UI: choose-your-own-adventure style branching narrative with knowledge-based choices and consequences.

name: Adaptive Difficulty Progression
description: Content difficulty adjusts automatically based on performance. UI: difficulty meter, mastery threshold tracking, unlocks harder content at 80%+ mastery, remedial loops for weak areas.

name: Incremental Reading
description: Read portions of multiple articles/texts in rotation, extracting key points as cards. UI: reading pane with priority queue, extract-as-card button, cloze-on-selection, progress tracking per article.

name: Deliberate Practice
description: Targeted practice on specific weaknesses with immediate feedback and repetition. UI: skill matrix identifying weak areas, targeted exercise generator, progress tracking per sub-skill.

name: Multi-Modal Note-Taking
description: Combine text, images, voice recordings, and web clippings in one note block. UI: rich note editor with /-commands for media embedding, voice recording widget, web clipper import.

name: Retrieval Practice with Feedback
description: Attempt to answer then receive immediate, detailed feedback explaining why the answer is correct/incorrect. UI: answer input → scoring → expandable explanation panel with related links.

name: Gamified Quiz Battles
description: Head-to-head or solo timed quizzes with points, streaks, leaderboards. UI: countdown timer, points animation, streak counter, combo multiplier, season rankings.

name: Case-Based Learning
description: Present real-world cases requiring application of knowledge to solve. UI: case narrative display, evidence tabs, diagnosis/solution input, expert solution comparison.

name: Spaced Handwriting Practice
description: Write characters/kanji/formulas with spaced repetition scheduling. UI: drawing canvas with stroke detection, recognition scoring, stroke order guide, SRS scheduling.
